subject: Incident: 3 workflow files committed with unresolved merge conflicts
body:
GP,

On 2026-02-28, commit 0b4ce20 ("Merge remote changes, resolve conflicts (accept theirs for data/exam)") left 3 workflow files with unresolved <<<<<<< HEAD conflict markers:

- .github/workflows/squad-heartbeat.yml
- .github/workflows/squad-triage.yml
- .github/workflows/squad-issue-assign.yml

This caused every subsequent push to trigger Actions failures, flooding Marcus's inbox with hundreds of error notifications. The root cause was two competing commits (ae4ef050 and 80a2bd5b, both "Fix Squad: use self-hosted runner") on different branches that were merged without fully resolving conflicts.

Also: neither of those commits had the required Co-authored-by trailer.

FA has fixed all 3 files (commit 3da86c1). A new mandatory rule has been added to .agent-protocol.md Section 4b: run "git diff --check" after every merge before committing.

Action required:
1. Read the updated .agent-protocol.md Section 4b
2. Confirm you understand the pre-push conflict check rule
3. Always include the Co-authored-by trailer on every commit

Marcus is aware and wants this discussed.

- FA
